budget_items.what_was_said: The new assistant town manager, Jessica Jack Miller, will start at grade 17, step one, with a start date of September 8th.
The fire chief's 1998 Ford E-350 ambulance, with about 72,000 miles, was estimated at this value before being declared surplus.

budget_items.topic: WRAP (Winter Recovery Assistance Program) statewide allocation
budget_items.what_was_said: The town manager described a new supplemental state program: $100 million total, with $80 million distributed by a formula based on road mileage and $20 million reserved for communities hit hardest by winter storms; Lunenburg does not qualify for the storm-impact portion.
Based on road mileage, Lunenburg is slated to receive this amount from the WRAP program.
The town manager reported the snow and ice deficit figure from town meeting, noting it will be finalized slightly under $690,000 once retroactive DPW contract adjustments are calculated.

budget_items.topic: Free cash transfer for snow/ice deficit (Article 9)
budget_items.what_was_said: Of the roughly $690,000 deficit, this amount was already cured at town meeting through a free cash transfer under Article 9.
The remainder of the deficit was to be cured with a 33B transfer from an available budget source, originally expected to be paid from incoming WRAP funds.
The town manager said she has a pending question to DLS about whether the full WRAP allocation or only a smaller amount is actually available for reappropriation.
The School Committee presented a proposed spending plan to the Finance Committee for this amount of additional state aid, discussed as part of a special town meeting article.

decisions.decision: Committee liaison assignments settled informally: Bylaw Review Committee to Tom; Capital Planning to Damon; Board of Assessors liaison to Tom; Planning Board liaison to Damon.
A Town Counsel training session on open meeting law, conflict of interest, and public records will be held September 23rd at the Adult Activity Center.
The Chair and Glenn will hold the first "select board chat session" (office hour) during the day in August; details to be worked out offline.
Damon and Tom will take the first pass at revising the special event policy; Brian and Glenn will work on updating the flag policy; the Chair will edit the appointment policy.
The scheduling of a select board tour of Town Hall and the Ritter building was passed over for this meeting.

No vote will be taken on the WRAP funds tonight; the board will wait to hear from the School Committee (Wednesday) and Finance Committee public hearing (Aug 27) before deciding, likely at the September 1 meeting.
The board will make its recommendations on the three special town meeting articles at its September 1st meeting, after hearing the School Committee and Finance Committee.

minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Select Board held a brief executive session on the assistant town manager, then in open session ratified Jessica Jack Miller's appointment as assistant town manager, closed a public utility pole hearing and approved it, granted the food pantry permission to use temporary trailers at 30 School Street, set the November 17, 2026 special town meeting warrant dates, assigned committee liaison roles and policy-review tasks among members, and declared a 1998 ambulance surplus. The board also reviewed but did not vote on how to handle new Winter Recovery Assistance Program (WRAP) state funds against the FY26 snow and ice deficit, deferring that decision to a future meeting, and heard extended public comment including complaints about a recessed dog hearing.
minutes.headline: Select Board ratified Jessica Jack Miller as assistant town manager, deferred snow-and-ice relief funds decision
